summary: Household: you (adult) and your son, in Oklahoma. Earnings about $25k to $35k a year, renting, everyone healthy. Several answers were unknown (your son's exact age, whether he is in public school, whether anyone has job-based health insurance, and savings). Recommended to apply: SNAP (likely eligible at this income for a household of 2); school meals (likely eligible if your son attends public school); EITC (likely, if your son is under 19 or a full-time student under 24); Child Tax Credit (likely, if your son is under 17); CHIP for your son (likely, if he is under 19 and not covered by job insurance); ACA marketplace premium tax credit (likely, if no job-based coverage is available to you). Not recommended: TANF and SSI (income too high or no qualifying disability or age factor). WIC not recommended unless your son is under 5 (the WIC income limit is in range, so check that). Adult Medicaid is borderline at this income for a household of 2 in Oklahoma, so a caseworker should check it. Hand off to a caseworker to confirm son's age, school enrollment, job coverage, and savings.
